entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The reformists would like that.""
entries.dialogueText: "The reformists would like that."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I agree. This really has no import..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. This really has no importance for the new Constitution. Also, Soll was a hero for many Sords, whether we like it or not."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, he is a hero for Sordland.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, he is a hero for Sordland."
entries.menuText: "Yes, he is a hero for Sordland."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Regardless of him, I see no proble..."
entries.dialogueText: "Regardless of him, I see no problem with having a special title for great heroes."
entries.menuText: "Regardless of him, I see no problem with having a special title for great heroes."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Even Mr. Clavin and our party's re..."
entries.dialogueText: "Even Mr. Clavin and our party's reformist wing has no problems with the current law. USP would fully support that decision. I guess we could also persuade Mr. Kibener somehow."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We'll never be able to get PFJP to..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll never be able to get PFJP to work with us. But if you can get Kesaro Kibener to work with you on this, our only remaining problem would be uniting our own party."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""You would be opening their way int..."
entries.dialogueText: "You would be opening their way into the parliament in the future if you were to decrease the threshold. It is important that you realize this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should abolish this position.""
entries.dialogueText: "We should abolish this position."
entries.menuText: "We should abolish this position."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No, I think we should respect this..."
entries.dialogueText: "No, I think we should respect this law."
entries.menuText: "No, I think we should respect this law."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Oh, so you want to use the same pr..."
entries.dialogueText: "Oh, so you want to use the same privilege after all."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Every President should gain that t..."
entries.dialogueText: "Every President should gain that title after their term."
entries.menuText: "Every President should gain that title after their term."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Some reformists suggested that the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some reformists suggested that the Assembly should nominate the ministers before the President approves them."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yeah, that's fair.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah, that's fair."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I think some of the reformists rea..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think some of the reformists really want to try him for his crimes during his terms. This law really has symbolic importance for both them and the Sollists."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you think they can be persuaded?""
entries.dialogueText: "Do you think they can be persuaded?"
entries.menuText: "Do you think they can be persuaded?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That's why only Tarquin Soll has i..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's why only Tarquin Soll has it. He gave it to himself right after his military coup. This law is basically made to save the Colonel."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""According to the Constitution, the..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to the Constitution, the Member of Honor not only has legal immunity but the state also covers most of their expenses as well as providing security at all times. It can only be given to someone by an absolute majority vote in the Assembly and the approval of the President."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian couldn't hide the surprised..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian couldn't hide the surprised look on his face.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should open their way and unite..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should open their way and unite the left."
entries.menuText: "We should open their way and unite the left."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""And the last one is the question a..."
entries.dialogueText: "And the last one is the question about Soll's legacy. Basically his *Member of Honor* law. It gave him absolute immunity even when he's retired. He is a permanent member of the Assembly as well, but luckily he doesn't really attend anymore."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I don't know how, but sure.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't know how, but sure."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""After pushing aggressive changes,..."
entries.dialogueText: "After pushing aggressive changes, I may need the same immunity."
entries.menuText: "After pushing aggressive changes, I may need the same immunity."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But it would be tougher to persuad..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it would be tougher to persuade the judges with this. Mrs. Edmonds and Mr. Garaci may not want to cooperate with you if they believe you're going to get rid of them afterwards."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'm afraid it would be tough to br..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm afraid it would be tough to bribe the Old Guards. Chief Justice Hawker will do their best to undermine us. But maybe we can get to Heron Garaci."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Albin Clavin and his reformist win..."
entries.dialogueText: "Albin Clavin and his reformist wing will be completely against you. He already responded negatively in the committee meetings. I think he would be tough to break."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Hell yes, we should.""
entries.dialogueText: "Hell yes, we should."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That's very bold, sir. But I like..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's very bold, sir. But I like it."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That might be the best thing to do..."
entries.dialogueText: "That might be the best thing to do for now. If we agitate the Court further, we might lose our chances with Mrs. Edmonds as well."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""However, the conservatives may be..."
entries.dialogueText: "However, the conservatives may be persuaded easier. The influence of Soll is still living strong in the party. They might follow you if they respect you as a strong leader."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Maybe we shouldn't make the Suprem..."
entries.dialogueText: "Maybe we shouldn't make the Supreme Court our enemies just yet. Let's keep the reforms light."
entries.menuText: "Maybe we shouldn't make the Supreme Court our enemies just yet."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should respect their immunity.""
entries.dialogueText: "We should respect their immunity."
entries.menuText: "We should respect their immunity."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I will instead give the President..."
entries.dialogueText: "I will instead give the President the ability to replace Judges as necessary."
entries.menuText: "I will instead give the President the ability to replace Judges as necessary."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should crush the Old Guards to..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should crush the Old Guards to clear ways for further reforms in Sordland."
entries.menuText: "We should crush the Old Guards to clear ways for further reforms."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""If we can remove their immunity or..."
entries.dialogueText: "If we can remove their immunity or define an impeachment process, we could clean the Court from Orso and his gang."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That is a fair concern. We'll need..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is a fair concern. We'll need to sway some of their members to succeed after all."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Sure. You'll have some time before..."
entries.dialogueText: "Sure. You'll have some time before we start writing the final proposal together."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I may need to think a bit longer a..."
entries.dialogueText: "I may need to think a bit longer about this."
entries.menuText: "I may need to think a bit longer about this."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""So we need as many of the conserva..."
entries.dialogueText: "So we need as many of the conservatives to support us. And there is one key person who can help us get their support."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""It's the question about the immuni..."
entries.dialogueText: "It's the question about the immunity of the Judges. While the Anti-Old Guard sentiment is increasing, there are talks that taking away their immunity would give us authority over judiciary."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""And there is one key person who ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "And there is one key person who can help us get their support."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Now I'll move unto the 8th Section..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now I'll move unto the 8th Section. We are reaching the end."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""And there is another key person wh..."
entries.dialogueText: "And there is another key person who can help us get their support."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We can also try to "persuade" the..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can also try to "persuade" the centrists of the Court. I think we might get Mr. Dalton and Mr. Martin with a bribe. The toughest will be Mrs. Edmonds."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We will leave it to the President..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will leave it to the President to decide."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Hey, if people keep electing one p..."
entries.dialogueText: "Hey, if people keep electing one person, that means they really are content. The masses are scared of change."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yes, we'll need to talk to Judge E..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we'll need to talk to Judge Edmonds. If we can get to her and Judge Garaci, we might be able to get enough votes. They have major influence."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A decrease is out of the question.""
entries.dialogueText: "A decrease is out of the question."
entries.menuText: "A decrease is out of the question."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""But of course, I don't.""
entries.dialogueText: "But of course, I don't."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yeah, it should be.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yeah, it should be."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Uh-oh.""
entries.dialogueText: "Uh-oh."
entries.menuText: "Uh-oh."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""For now I'll move onto the next on..."
entries.dialogueText: "For now I'll move onto the next one: Term Limits.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes. Tarquin Soll governed for twe..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. Tarquin Soll governed for twenty years. It seems his magic is slowly vanishing from the minds of the people, for they believe term limits are necessary."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I agree, we could keep that in.""
entries.dialogueText: "I agree, we could keep that in."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""According to the Constitution, Nia..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to the Constitution, Nia Morgna is a member of the Supreme Court, which means we already have one vote against this. I know two of the judges who are with her, as well."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Unlikely to have 100% vote to pass..."
entries.dialogueText: "Unlikely to have 100% vote to pass. But I hear you."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Because we could use it too.""
entries.dialogueText: "Because we could use it too."
entries.menuText: "Because we could use it too."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That would be enough to hold him a..."
entries.dialogueText: "That would be enough to hold him accountable for his actions but why would you want to keep such the title then?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Term Limits?""
entries.dialogueText: "Term Limits?"
entries.menuText: "Term Limits?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We could keep the title but take a..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could keep the title but take away the immunity clause."
entries.menuText: "We could keep the title but take away the immunity clause."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We will also need to get more vote..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will also need to get more votes from the conservative judges. I believe Heron Garaci might be the weakest link of the Old Guards. He can help us get the 6 votes needed."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We could try to balance it with th..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could try to balance it with the reformists and make it dependent on an enabling act from the Assembly. Sure, it would make the whole process longer but as long as we have a majority, nothing really changes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yes, we can make it dependent on e..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we can make it dependent on enabling acts."
entries.menuText: "Yes, we can make it dependent on enabling acts."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Mr. Ricter will probably demand th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Mr. Ricter will probably demand that we remove them completely. I doubt that this would be enough to get him to sit down with us."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't think presidential decrees..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't think presidential decrees need any reforms."
entries.menuText: "I don't think presidential decrees need any reforms."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Me neither. I think it's important..."
entries.dialogueText: "Me neither. I think it's important that the President can act quickly on matters of national importance."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We'll need to reach out to Judge E..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll need to reach out to Judge Edmonds and her centrist wing. We can get three votes from them. They don't seem to be in the pocket of the Old Guard and they are definitely not reformists."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes, it could be destabilizing.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, it could be destabilizing."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't aim to leave any time soon..."
entries.dialogueText: "I don't aim to leave any time soon. We keep the unlimited terms."
entries.menuText: "I don't aim to leave any time soon. We keep the unlimited terms."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I'm sure it's possible. But regard..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure it's possible. But regardless of my opinion, we *need* to persuade most of them to support us for passing an amendment to the Constitution."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We can't allow communists to enter..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't allow communists to enter the Assembly."
entries.menuText: "We can't allow communists to enter the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""The conservatives have around 40 s..."
entries.dialogueText: "The conservatives have around 40 seats. If you can get the unaligned to support us, along with our "loyalists" we'll have enough votes."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""So, we don't even have a vote in t..."
entries.dialogueText: "So, we don't even have a vote in the Court?"
entries.menuText: "So, we don't even have a vote in the Court?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Who do you think would be willing..."
entries.dialogueText: "Who do you think would be willing to support these changes?"
entries.menuText: "Who do you think would be willing to support these changes?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should strengthen the decrees f..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should strengthen the decrees further, so they have priority over statute law."
entries.menuText: "We should strengthen the decrees further, so they have priority over statute law."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""You could technically choose to ta..."
entries.dialogueText: "You could technically choose to take no action instead of signing or vetoing it. Without a proper definition of the process, it would be perfectly legal for you to ignore a bill indefinitely."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That is pretty powerful, indeed. T..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is pretty powerful, indeed. That may scare some of our ministers too if you decide to *rule by decree.*"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm sure they can be bought.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure they can be bought."
entries.menuText: "I'm sure they can be bought."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We are at the 6th. This is about t..."
entries.dialogueText: "We are at the 6th. This is about the presidential decrees. You already know that the reformists want them to be removed or limited. But I'm guessing you do not want any changes to your already powerful decrees, sir."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian continued with the next sect..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian continued with the next section.

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Well, we could define a process fo..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, we could define a process for the Assembly to override your vetoes with a supermajority. While this limits your veto capabilities, if we do not define a time limit for the President to act on a bill..."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""You'll have some time to think abo..."
entries.dialogueText: "You'll have some time to think about your decision, sir."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll show them true leadership.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll show them true leadership."
entries.menuText: "I'll show them true leadership."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I agree. If we're going against th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. If we're going against the reformists anyway, why even bother giving concessions?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: LateDictatorKeyFigureHub

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That said, we should try to reach..."
entries.dialogueText: "That said, we should try to reach common ground with NFP and the conservative wing of our party to be able to propose such changes in the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes, they are already trying to hi..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, they are already trying to hit you since they are expecting reforms. But we aim to cooperate with some of the judges to make sure that doesn't happen."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""What if we don't succeed? The Cour..."
entries.dialogueText: "What if we don't succeed? The Court can have me impeached for this."
entries.menuText: "What if we don't succeed? The Court can have me impeached for this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We could add the Assembly in the p..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could add the Assembly in the process but make impeachment only possible with an absolute majority."
entries.menuText: "We could add the Assembly in the process but make impeachment possible only with an absolute majority."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We'll get rid of this law entirely.""
entries.dialogueText: "We'll get rid of this law entirely."
entries.menuText: "We'll get rid of this law entirely."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""How many votes do they have?""
entries.dialogueText: "How many votes do they have?"
entries.menuText: "How many votes do they have?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I like the idea. Maybe we could co..."
entries.dialogueText: "I like the idea. Maybe we could convince some of the reformists with that. But it all depends on the whole changes. It could be better not to change anything."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's mess with the Court, divide..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's mess with the Court, divide and conquer them. They have it coming."
entries.menuText: "Let's mess with the Court, divide and conquer them."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That's a good idea. That'd make im..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a good idea. That'd make impeachment close to impossible."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""This is already what our administr..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is already what our administration wanted to do."
entries.menuText: "This is already what we wanted to do."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""No. We don't need to change the Ar..."
entries.dialogueText: "No. We don't need to change the Article about vetoes."
entries.menuText: "No. We don't need to change the Article about vetoes."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I see.""
entries.dialogueText: "I see."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We could try to make the impeachme..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could try to make the impeachment process more difficult or entirely get rid of it. A change like this would give you free reign. However, that might be going a little too far."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""This is regarding the appointment..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is regarding the appointment of ministers. Currently, the President is free to appoint anyone from the members of the Assembly. Nobody else is involved with the process."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Decreasing the threshold might mea..."
entries.dialogueText: "Decreasing the threshold might mean opening their way into the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That is not bad idea. As long as w..."
entries.dialogueText: "That is not bad idea. As long as we are the majority in the Assembly, that does not change too much."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I guess so.""
entries.dialogueText: "I guess so."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We could limit the vetoes and pack..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could limit the vetoes and package it as a great reform."
entries.menuText: "We could limit the vetoes and package it as a great reform."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I agree. We should involve the Ass..."
entries.dialogueText: "I agree. We should involve the Assembly more in the process."
entries.menuText: "I agree. We should involve the Assembly more in the process."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yes, we'll need the rip some of th..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, we'll need the rip some of the sheep Judges out of the herd in the process."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Can we pass it through the Supreme..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can we pass it through the Supreme Court?"
entries.menuText: "Can we pass it through the Supreme Court?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'll move on to Section 4.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll move on to Section 4."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Can we possibly reach a two-thirds..."
entries.dialogueText: "Can we possibly reach a two-thirds majority in the Assembly?"
entries.menuText: "Can we possibly reach a two-thirds majority in the Assembly?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I like the idea. What kind of loop..."
entries.dialogueText: "I like the idea. What kind of loopholes do you have in mind?"
entries.menuText: "I like the idea. What kind of loopholes do you have in mind?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We could introduce a confidence vo..."
entries.dialogueText: "We could introduce a confidence vote."
entries.menuText: "We could introduce a confidence vote."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Or better yet, we could change the..."
entries.dialogueText: "Or better yet, we could change the article according to their demands but establish new loopholes for you to hold your veto powers."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Of course.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""An increase on the other hand is m..."
entries.dialogueText: "An increase on the other hand is more complex. NFP could be out of the Assembly but that would mean PFJP's seats would get higher too, if we're left with only two parties in the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should keep using the threshold..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should keep using the threshold to our advantage."
entries.menuText: "We should keep using the threshold to our advantage."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Don't worry. With these reforms, w..."
entries.dialogueText: "Don't worry. With these reforms, we will be even more popular."
entries.menuText: "Don't worry. With these reforms, we will be even more popular."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We can't just give away our majori..."
entries.dialogueText: "We can't just give away our majority like that anyway."
entries.menuText: "We can't just give away our majority like that anyway."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Well, we can't know these for sure..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, we can't know these for sure. In the last elections, the Socialist Party and the Worker's Party of Bludia both had close to ten percent. One of them may very well increase their votes in the next years."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Jump to: [LateDictatorKeyFigureHub]

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Yes, Mr. President.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, Mr. President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's get into the details of our..."
entries.dialogueText: "Let's get into the details of our *reforms.*"
entries.menuText: "Let's get into the details of our *reforms.*"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""It's fine as it is.""
entries.dialogueText: "It's fine as it is."
entries.menuText: "It's fine as it is."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I'm sure some of the reformists ma..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure some of the reformists may support that."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""So there is no reason to change th..."
entries.dialogueText: "So there is no reason to change this unless you want to sell this to the opposition parties. Sharing the power with the Assembly may make them sympathetic to you. This might be important for the NFP as well."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""They will surely support a just ca..."
entries.dialogueText: "They will surely support a just cause for the country and its future."
entries.menuText: "They will surely support a just cause for the country and its future."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We need at least 6 of the 11 judge..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need at least 6 of the 11 judges to vote for the proposal. But Mr. Hawker has enormous influence over the judges."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""They are the biggest obstacle. Eve..."
entries.dialogueText: "They are the biggest obstacle. Even if we pass the Assembly, the Chief Justice will do his best to block our amendments."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I hope so.""
entries.dialogueText: "I hope so."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Did you already work on a plan?""
entries.dialogueText: "Did you already work on a plan?"
entries.menuText: "Did you already work on a plan?"

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I agree, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "I agree, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We need the majority of our 130 se..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need the majority of our 130 seats in the Assembly to vote in favour. But without NFP's support of 40 votes, we can never surpass the needed 166. Mr. Kibener's full support as well as our party is needed."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Of course not.""
entries.dialogueText: "Of course not."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I understand sir. We will address..."
entries.dialogueText: "I understand sir. We will address it later in that case."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian pulled out a huge dossier fr..."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian pulled out a huge dossier from his briefcase.

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Yea, I am not so sure about this.""
entries.dialogueText: "Yea, I am not so sure about this."
entries.menuText: "Yea, I am not so sure about this."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Let's proceed.""
entries.dialogueText: "Let's proceed."
entries.menuText: "Let's proceed."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Excellent, and it gives us additio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Excellent, and it gives us additional options."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We should reach out to the judges..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should reach out to the judges in secret. Some of them might be willing to break rank to support us."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""And what good does that do to us?""
entries.dialogueText: "And what good does that do to us?"
entries.menuText: "And what good does that do to us?"

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We need the Court to even pass thi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We need the Court to even pass this change. Why on earth would they support this?"
entries.menuText: "We need the Court to even pass this change. Why on earth would they support this?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But if we keep the same voter base..."
entries.dialogueText: "But if we keep the same voter base, say a 15% threshold would keep NFP out of the Assembly. Leaving only two parties. Unless, Frens also falls back behind."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We will be ensuring that the Supre..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will be ensuring that the Supreme Court can no longer block constitutional changes."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Most of them won't. But we already..."
entries.dialogueText: "Most of them won't. But we already talked about a possible agreement with Isabel which may change things. We could potentially get Heron and the Sollist judges as well."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Moving on to Section 3. This is ab..."
entries.dialogueText: "Moving on to Section 3. This is about the impeachment process of the President. Currently, in cases of high treason and breaking the Constitution, the Supreme Court may impeach and try the President."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I can't disagree with that stateme..."
entries.dialogueText: "I can't disagree with that statement."
entries.menuText: "I can't disagree with that."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Glad to hear it, sir.""
entries.dialogueText: "Glad to hear it, sir."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Most people already find the Supre..."
entries.dialogueText: "Most people already find the Supreme Court's absolute authority over constitutional changes dangerous. Look at the situation we currently have, Mr. President. The Judiciary has power over every branch."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""That's why the Old Guard have barg..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's why the Old Guard have bargaining chips over us."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""This law is particularly dangerous..."
entries.dialogueText: "This law is particularly dangerous for you in this case. We will be going against the Old Guard, and if we prove to be successful in the Assembly..."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Of course, according to the ratio..."
entries.dialogueText: "Of course, according to the ratio of the party's in government. In our case, it's only us."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yes. This will ensure that the Sup..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes. This will ensure that the Supreme Court will no longer have absolute power over legislation. We can persuade the other parties with this too."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""...They will be looking for anythi..."
entries.dialogueText: "...They will be looking for anything they can declare unconstitutional to tackle you. All they need is the Supreme Court to impeach you."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""But it will be tough to unite the..."
entries.dialogueText: "But it will be tough to unite the USP with all the divisive wings that have formed. You must make them follow you loyally."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I have established nine points par..."
entries.dialogueText: "I have established nine points parallel to the demands of the reformists. I'll go through each of them and get your input."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'm sure they will.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'm sure they will."
entries.menuText: "I'm sure they will."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""But don't forget that the Socialis..."
entries.dialogueText: "But don't forget that the Socialist party and the Worker's Party of Bludia both had close to ten percent vote in the last election."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We will do what's necessary to get..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will do what's necessary to get them in line."
entries.menuText: "We will do what's necessary to get them in line."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Some would but it would be possibl..."
entries.dialogueText: "Some would but it would be possible to pass it, so it doesn't really matter."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I don't see anything wrong with it.""
entries.dialogueText: "I don't see anything wrong with it."
entries.menuText: "I don't see anything wrong with it."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We did it before for the elections..."
entries.dialogueText: "We did it before for the elections. We can unite it again."
entries.menuText: "We did it before for the elections. We can unite it again."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""I'll make sure they follow me.""
entries.dialogueText: "I'll make sure they follow me."
entries.menuText: "I'll make sure they follow me."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Now if we are going with this dire..."
entries.dialogueText: "Now if we are going with this direction, I'll need everybody to focus."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""A pocket veto? Wouldn't the reform..."
entries.dialogueText: "A pocket veto? Wouldn't the reformist see through that?"
entries.menuText: "A pocket veto? Wouldn't the reformist see through that?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I know you will. If you can get th..."
entries.dialogueText: "I know you will. If you can get their support, we'll have enough votes to amend the Constitution, counting we have the support of Mr. Kibener too."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""According to such change, constitu..."
entries.dialogueText: "According to such change, constitutional amendments will still require the two-thirds vote system to be able to propose a change. However, the judiciary will not have the final say in the amendments."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""You have our attention.""
entries.dialogueText: "You have our attention."
entries.menuText: "You have our attention."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Yes, but this is a delicate matter..."
entries.dialogueText: "Yes, but this is a delicate matter. All the party, and I mean, not even Albin wants us to decrease the threshold. They think that... this would destroy our party in the long term."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We should definitely work to decre..."
entries.dialogueText: "We should definitely work to decrease the threshold to some degree."
entries.menuText: "We should definitely work to decrease the threshold to some degree."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""Do you think it would really hurt..."
entries.dialogueText: "Do you think it would really hurt the party?"
entries.menuText: "Do you think it would really hurt the party?"

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Two major left parties; the Social..."
entries.dialogueText: "Two major left parties; the Socialist Party and the Worker's Party of Bludia both had close to ten percent vote in the last election."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""Well, we don't. I doubt that any o..."
entries.dialogueText: "Well, we don't. I doubt that any of the judges would support such changes just like that. But they can surely be bribed."

entries.speaker: Player
entries.title: Player: ""We could simply increase it.""
entries.dialogueText: "We could simply increase it."
entries.menuText: "We could simply increase it."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""Not wrong. The ten percent thresho..."
entries.dialogueText: "Not wrong. The ten percent threshold is what that allowed us to control half of the Assembly with around one third of the majority in the elections."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""The fifth section is about our inf..."
entries.dialogueText: "The fifth section is about our infamous electoral threshold. Most reformists want to lower the threshold as much as possible. We could try working with them but it is simpler to keep the law."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""A decrease would definitely hurt o..."
entries.dialogueText: "A decrease would definitely hurt our position in the future. If another party is elected to the Assembly, our projected vote would be closer to the real vote, which is significantly lesser."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""10% seems already too high for man..."
entries.dialogueText: "10% seems already too high for many, sir. An increase may bring too much attention on the amendments."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""That's a possibility. It might mak..."
entries.dialogueText: "That's a possibility. It might make the reformists more willing to consider the changes."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Lucian looked sceptical."
entries.dialogueText: Lucian looked sceptical.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""We will definitely need to work wi..."
entries.dialogueText: "We will definitely need to work with some of the Old Guard aligned judges."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""We'll start with Section 1. Reform..."
entries.dialogueText: "We'll start with Section 1. Reformists want your absolute veto power to be removed, or at least, limited. We could potentially give them what they want by limiting it. It wouldn't cause problems since we already have the majority in the Assembly."

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""This is a point that was unanimous..."
entries.dialogueText: "This is a point that was unanimously agreed on by all parties. Tarquin Soll established this rule to protect his '29 Constitution. We can break the power of the Old Guards with this."

entries.speaker: Lucian Galade
entries.title: Lucian Galade: ""I'll move on to the second point t..."
entries.dialogueText: "I'll move on to the second point then. The new Constitution should remove the Supreme Court out of the constitutional amendment process. Not only popular, it would also strengthen our position against the judiciary."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Nia was taken aback by the statemen..."
entries.dialogueText: Nia was taken aback by the statement.

entries.speaker: Petr Vectern
entries.title: Petr Vectern: ""I think we can reach out to Judge..."
entries.dialogueText: "I think we can reach out to Judge Edmonds. And in extension, Mr. Dalton and Mr. Martin. They aren't working together with the Old Guards, as far as we know."
